title: Connes Embedding Problem
exact_target: Can every finite tracial von Neumann algebra be represented, without changing its trace, inside an ultrapower of the hyperfinite type II-one factor?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1104 (ALG-004). CC BY 4.0.

Isaac Goldbring, \emph{The Connes Embedding Problem: A Guided Tour}, arXiv:2109.12682v1 (2021), §3.6, pp.20--22, official statement and its larger-index-set variation. The abstract and §§6--7 explain that the classical universal assertion has a negative answer as a consequence of MIP$^*=$RE.
